review.why: Plans website structure: page hierarchy, navigation, URL patterns and internal linking, drawn as text trees and Mermaid diagrams.
review.summary: Collects context, gives starting structures by site type, and covers hierarchy depth, header and footer navigation rules, URL principles and common mistakes, breadcrumbs and internal linking with hub-and-spoke and a link audit. Deliverables are an ASCII tree, a Mermaid sitemap, a URL map table, a navigation spec and a linking plan.
strengths: Concrete rules: four to seven nav items, lowercase hyphenated URLs, no orphan pages
Always asks which URLs need redirects when restructuring
Outputs a structure and a sitemap diagram you can hand to a team
cautions: The three-click rule and links-per-word figures are rules of thumb
Platform and migration advice is in a file not read here
